question: At which of the following places was the final match of the T20 Blind Cricket World Cup 2022 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The final match of the **T20 Blind Cricket World Cup 2022** was held at the **M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, India**.
 
• The tournament was organized by the **Cricket Association for the Blind in India (CABI)** under the aegis of the World Blind Cricket Council (WBCC).
 
• India emerged victorious in the final match, showcasing exceptional skills and teamwork to retain their title as champions of blind cricket.
 
• The T20 Blind Cricket World Cup 2022 featured participation from multiple countries, promoting inclusivity and accessibility in sports.
 
• Bengaluru, as the host city, played a pivotal role in providing world-class facilities for the players and organizing a successful event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blind Cricket**

 
 
• Blind cricket is a version of cricket adapted for players with visual impairments, governed by the World Blind Cricket Council (WBCC).
 
• The ball used in blind cricket is larger and emits sound to assist players in tracking it.
 
• Players are categorized into three groups based on their visual impairment: B1 (totally blind), B2 (partially blind), and B3 (partially sighted).
 
 
 
• **M. Chinnaswamy Stadium**
 
 
• Located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, it is one of India's premier cricket stadiums and home to the Karnataka State Cricket Association (KSCA).
 
• The stadium has hosted numerous international matches and is also the home ground for the Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
 
 
• **World Blind Cricket Council (WBCC)**
 
 
• The WBCC is the governing body for blind cricket worldwide, promoting the sport among visually impaired athletes.
 
• It organizes international tournaments, including the T20 Blind Cricket World Cup.
 
 
 
• **Cricket Association for the Blind in India (CABI)**
 
 
• CABI is an independent entity affiliated with the WBCC, responsible for promoting and organizing blind cricket in India.
 
• It plays a critical role in identifying talent and ensuring participation in international tournaments.
